entry.title: Develop an Open Source Lesson with the UC OSPO Network
entry.summary: The UC OSPO Network is running four Carpentries Collaborative Lesson Development Training cohorts this summer and fall. We're looking for people to join an already-scoped lesson team or propose a new lesson.
